BiblicalUsage: The word is the beginning, the first part. The fear of the Lord is the beginning of wisdom, and the knowledge of the holy is understanding; Daniel's vision came in the third year of Belshazzar, at the first, when he had seen the vision before; and Ruth came to Bethlehem in the beginning of barley harvest.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the beginning of wisdom is the fear of the Lord, and Ruth's beginning in Bethlehem was the start of a new life.
